name: meeple-as-card-v1
description: THE ARM. The handoff-v2 design in full (Dean, 04/09/2026 evening, docs/meeple-loop-visit-handoff-2026-09-04-v2.md), read against the shipped v1 meeple loop (overlays/meeple-loop-v1.overlay.json is now a no-op naming the same default, so the real control here is the base game with none of these three knobs set). THE DIAGNOSIS IT IS BUILT ON. v1 measured 0.13 short of the hook floor and starving in the back half - 13.4 meeples a game boxed by the cap, rival visits falling from 95k before midgame to 73k after - and Dean's reading was that a meeple with no competing use is a coupon, not a cost: spending it is not a decision. The Feld lens agrees, a currency that does nothing else reads as bookkeeping. The fix is to give the meeple a second use in cards, and to price the blocked slot instead of refusing it outright. WHAT THE ARM CHANGES, ALL AT ONCE, so a null result is informative and a positive one is not attributable to a single lever. R15 (meepleAsCard true): a meeple of a colour may pay wherever a card of that colour would - build costs including the n-of-suit requirements and the 2-own-suit Power/Endgame cost, a Grow's activation payment, a delivery crate - and a meeple spent this way goes straight to the box, never a hand, a barn or a stack, and never counts toward the hand limit. Two meeples still pay as one card of any colour, R10's wild pair reused rather than re-rated. A meeple paid into a Grow does not join the stack or count toward the threshold, so it can activate a building already at capacity - a priced clog bypass, deliberate. R4 amended (meepleCapPerColour 2): the supply cap doubles, a processing bound rather than a design rule in Dean's own words - 'let's see if this is actually a problem before we try to fix it' - so the boxed-by-cap count must be tracked and reported by source, not assumed away. R6 amended (slotToll 1): a slot is never blocked any more, only priced. Visiting a slot already holding k meeples costs k extra meeples of any colours on top of the acting one, and the toll is boxed, not handed to the host - nothing is ever refused. READ IN THIS ORDER, per section 3 of the handoff, and read the noise floor before any of them. (1) THE HOOK, rival visits per player per turn against 0.5, then the bonus mix four ways. (2) ACTIONS PER TURN against the 1.5 target set 04/09/2026 evening (main plus bought doors; Collect draws on their own line), with game length beside it. (3) MEEPLES SPENT AS RESOURCES, per game and by use - build / activation / delivery - with activations of an at-threshold building paid by a meeple counted apart, and as a share of all meeple exits: this is the new dial and the number that says whether the two uses compete or one dominates. (4) MEEPLES BOXED BY SOURCE: collect cap, island cap, resource by use, toll. (5) THE POOL BY ROUND - a pool that empties by midgame is the coin drought again. (6) THE HOARD-AND-DUMP LINE: median supply in the last third, and the share of resource spends in the final two rounds. (7) TOLL VISITS: share of visits paying a toll, mean toll paid, and whether the popular farm changes hands. (8) DELIVERIES PER PLAYER AND THE BARN GLUT, since meeples now pay crates. (9) WORST-CASE LEGAL MOVES AND SECONDS PER 2-SEAT GAME against the v1 arm - stop if either has moved by more than 2x, because meeples now enter the payment enumerator and must be handled as counts of interchangeable tokens per colour, never as individual cards in the subset enumeration, or this is the 12-card hand-limit blowup again with meeples standing in for the extra cards. ⚠️ AT THIS STAGE OF THE BUILD the engine does not yet read meepleAsCard or slotToll at all, so running this overlay currently behaves exactly like the shipped v1 loop under meepleCapPerColour 2 - that is expected and is not a result.
